text: Baghsar Fort Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Baghsar Fort Type: Monument - Fort Province: Azad Jammu and Kashmir District: Bhimber Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1526 - 1857 CE Description: The fort is located around 12 km from Samahni town, Bhimber. The fort is built with brick laid in lime mortar, with multi-faceted structure. These four storied structures have played an important role in the history during the times of Ahmed Shah Abdali, Ranjit Singh and Gulab Singh. It is said that the Mughal Emperor Jahangir, on his way back from the Kashmir Valley, fell ill and ultimately died in this fort. It is tentatively assigned to the 16th century CE.
